title: A countdown calendar
description:
Work with dates: how long until upcoming events, and what day they fall on.

```
Today: 2026-11-20 (Friday)
Holiday       2026-12-24  in 34 days (Thursday)
New year      2027-01-01  in 42 days (Friday)
Past event    2026-10-01  was 50 days ago
```

starter.main.py:
from datetime import date

today = date(2026, 11, 20)
events = [("New year", "2027-01-01"), ("Past event", "2026-10-01"), ("Holiday", "2026-12-24")]
